messages:
jules: Quick product ask: add a tiny cost-preview hovercard when you hover an SKU in Console. Show estimated delta for per-model token cost + cache savings for routing policy changes.

sam: Good idea. reduces surprises when flipping routing. :thumbsup:

katie: UX: default window 7d? need short headline and expandable breakdown.

jules: 7d default, show confidence band and label it 'preview'. include gen vs emb tokens.

pranav: Technical: cache savings depend on seq-shape. include sample_rate, variance bucket and a warmup line for sticky routing.

maria: Product wants internal API so SRE/support can fetch same preview. we also need per-org opt-out flag.

sam: API sketch: GET /internal/console/cost_preview?route=R&id=... returns model_summaries, token_delta, est_cost_delta, sample_rate, decision_id. UI should format currency.

ops-bot: Recommend 60s LRU caching via /internal/cache-preview. include X-Internal-Key and cache key parts: route|policy|sample_rate|tz.

pranav: Also include cache-freshness flag in response. warmup sparkline (0-24h) required.

katie: UX: headline like "~$0.30/day" rounded + expand for per-model and cache vs model run. advanced view shows GPU time.

sam: Actions: pr/eng prototype API + cache; frontend mock; product copy; ops throttle/feature-flag.

maria: I'll open GH issue with acceptance criteria and link mock.

jules: thanks, ping when GH issue is up. should reduce surprise burn during routing experiments. :party_popper:
